title: After Hegseth Impeachment Vote Fails, Massie Vows More Tough Votes for GOP In His Final Days
summary: Representative Thomas Massie, the Kentucky Republican, said he would use his waning time in office to prod his party to vote for “sanity” and break with President Trump.
body_markdown: Representative Thomas Massie, the Kentucky Republican, said he would use his waning time in office to prod his party to vote for “sanity” and break with President Trump.
